title: Atlas contracts — common types (v1)
description: Shared catalogue vocabulary for the Atlas asset model. Catalogue concepts only: no integration-criticality, EOL risk, portfolio scoring or AI review (those work with the data and live in the private Atlas core). See handbook 11 §1.

AssetKind.description: The kind of asset held in the catalogue.

Lifecycle.description: Catalogue lifecycle state. Held metadata, not analysis.

AssetId.description: Stable, opaque identifier for an asset. Never reused, never re-meaning'd once published.

Tag.description: Manual, lightweight classification. A key with an optional value.
